purpose: Restore full Q0/C0 algorithm profiles. This manifest is not a runnable job, input identity attestation, or online performance-parity claim.

gpu_policy.egl_mapping_status: Inherited historical physical CUDA7 -> EGL4 mapping; current hardware/runtime preflight must verify before dispatch.

runtime_bindings_required.main.episode_num: Count of episodes dispatched for this attempt.
runtime_bindings_required.main.episode_seed_schedule: Singleton frozen env_seed; task and policy seed are separately bound by frozen-seed-plan.json.
runtime_bindings_required.backend.libero.task_ids_filter: Frozen ordered task IDs for this attempt.
runtime_bindings_required.main.cached_functions_dir: Owned guidance cache copied from audited historical cache with matching content hashes.
runtime_bindings_required.main.eds_eval.method_label: Q0/C0 historical label or frozen unambiguous new label.
runtime_bindings_required.LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH: Owned config whose BDDL/assets/init paths and content hashes match frozen input manifest.
runtime_bindings_required.perception_provider_identity: Freeze actual Stage/reward API provider and model identity separately; no credentials in artifacts.
runtime_bindings_required.init_state_identity: Freeze actual init index/content hash per task/seed, including consumed history.
runtime_bindings_required.seed: Frozen policy_seed for each fresh episode subprocess; paired across arms. Historical profile seed=0 is provenance only.

compute_identity.initial_denoise_steps: Checkpoint scheduler default, policy.rdt.num_inference_steps=null; freeze resolved number from model config before dispatch.
compute_identity.model_forward_calls: Measure separately; 176 is candidate scoring count, not diffusion-forward count. RBF gradient/fallback and scheduler paths affect actual forward calls.

new_input_contract.cache: canonical guidance bytes preserved; task-bound identity metadata validated by opt-in main guard
new_input_contract.rng: One fresh process per task with explicit env_seed and policy_seed. Historical sequential policy RNG is not replayed; rebaseline all arms under this contract.
